errors.evidence:
### 1. Task outcome (short version):
I was unable to locate an archived version of the official Ben & Jerry’s Flavor Graveyard page (from the end of 2022) that clearly shows the photo with the oldest flavor’s headstone and its inscription.

### 2. Task outcome (extremely detailed version):
I began by identifying the official Flavor Graveyard page on Ben & Jerry’s website and attempted to locate an archived version corresponding to the end of 2022 using the Wayback Machine. I tried several URL variants (including https://www.benjerry.com/flavors/flavor-graveyard and https://www.benjerry.com/flavors) and adjusted the archival date parameters, but none returned an archived snapshot that included the specific photo showing the oldest flavor’s headstone. Additionally, manual searches and on-page text searches for keywords like ‘headstone’ did not reveal the inscription or additional contextual details about the specific photo. Consequently, I could not extract the full inscription, nor isolate the last line of the rhyme, as required.
